name: Frame Counter
description: Live click-gap HUD: counts how many frames you had between inputs (10-15, 7-9, 5-6, 4, 3, 2, 1, sub-frame CBS). Works for live play, macros and bots.

enabled.name: Enable HUD
enabled.description: Show the frame counter HUD in levels.

compact-mode.name: Compact Mode
compact-mode.description: Smaller HUD: hides extra readouts and empty CBS / 16+ rows.

color-code.name: Color-coded Rows
color-code.description: Loose gaps are green, tight gaps are red.

show-session.name: Show Session Totals
show-session.description: Adds the session total (all attempts) in brackets next to each count.

show-tps.name: Show TPS
show-tps.description: Detected physics steps per second (frames are physics steps).

cbs-toast.name: (with cbs) Notice
cbs-toast.description: Flashes '(with cbs)' at the top of the screen for 1 second when a sub-frame gap happens.

summary-on-complete.name: Summary On Completion
summary-on-complete.description: Popup with the attempt's counts when you beat a level (not practice).

save-stats.name: Save Stats File
save-stats.description: Appends session stats per level to a text file in the mod's save folder when you leave a level.

reset-position.name: Reset HUD Position
reset-position.description: Turn on, then enter a level: the HUD goes back to the top-left and this switches itself off. To move the HUD: pause and drag it.
